game.name: Pokemon Yellow Version (Full GBC Color)
game.desc: Special Pikachu Edition in full Game Boy Color! Travel across Kanto with Pikachu following behind you and collect all 150 Kanto Pokemon.

game.name: Pokemon Gold Version
game.desc: Journey across the Johto and Kanto regions with Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile, discover 100 new Gen II Pokemon, and encounter the legendary Ho-Oh!

game.name: Pokemon Silver Version
game.desc: Explore Johto and Kanto with day/night real-time clock events, earn 16 Gym Badges, and awaken the legendary guardian of the seas, Lugia!

game.name: Pokemon Crystal Version
game.desc: The definitive Generation II Pokemon adventure featuring animated Pokemon battle sprites, the Battle Tower, and the quest for the legendary Suicune!
